ewenloy_starkflow.name: StarkFlow
ewenloy_starkflow.description: Simple multiplayer: rooms, events and shared room state with atomic add.

server-url.name: Server URL
server-url.desc: WebSocket address of your StarkFlow server, for example ws://localhost:8080/ws

app-id.name: App ID
app-id.desc: Name of your game on the server. Rooms of different app ids never mix.

log-level.name: Log level
log-level.desc: What the plugin writes to the browser console.

auto-reconnect.name: Auto reconnect
auto-reconnect.desc: Reconnect and rejoin the room automatically after a connection loss.

on-connected.description: Triggered when the server accepted the connection (also after an automatic reconnect).

on-disconnected.description: Triggered when the connection is closed for good.

on-reconnecting.description: Triggered each time the plugin schedules a reconnect attempt.

is-connected.description: True while connected to the server.

on-joined-room.description: Triggered when you entered a room (also after a rejoin; see Resumed).

on-left-room.description: Triggered after you left a room.

on-room-list.description: Triggered when the room list arrived.

is-in-room.description: True while you are in a room.

is-host.description: True if you are the host (the oldest active player) of the room.

on-player-joined.description: Triggered when another player entered the room. Read LastPlayerId.

on-player-left.description: Triggered when a player left for good. Read LastPlayerId.

on-player-suspended.description: Triggered when a player lost the connection. The place is kept for a while. Read LastPlayerId.

on-player-resumed.description: Triggered when a player with a lost connection came back. Read LastPlayerId.

on-host-changed.description: Triggered when another player became the host. Read HostId.

on-player-prop-changed.description: Triggered when a player property changed. Read LastPlayerId.

on-event.description: Triggered when an event with this code arrived. Read EventData and EventFrom.

on-any-event.description: Triggered for every event that arrived.

on-state-changed.description: Triggered when this state key changed.

on-error.description: Triggered when the server sent an error. Read ErrorCode and ErrorMsg.

connect.description: Connect to the server. Leave both empty to use the project properties and the saved token.

set-auth-token.description: Use a token you saved yourself (for example in the cloud save) at the next Connect.

set-name.description: Name sent to the server at the next Connect.

join-or-create.display-text: Join or create room [i]{0}[/i] (max players [i]{1}[/i], delete when empty after [i]{2}[/i] s)
join-or-create.description: Enter the room, create it if it does not exist. Max players 0 = server default. Delete time -1 = server default, 0 = at once.

request-rooms.description: Ask the server for the list of rooms.

send-event.description: Send an event to the room. Target: others, all, or a player id.

data.name: Data
data.desc: Text data (you build the format, for example x,y,angle).

to.name: To
to.desc: others, all or a player id.

set-state.description: Write a number or a text to the shared room state.

set-state-bool.description: Write a boolean to the shared room state.

add-state.description: Atomically add a number (can be negative) to a state key. The server applies it in order, so nothing is lost.

set-player-prop.description: Set a property of your player that everybody sees (ready flag, color...).

auth-token.description: Your signed token. Save it to keep the same identity on this device.

ping.description: Round trip time to the server in milliseconds.

server-time.description: Server time in milliseconds (corrected for the clock offset).

status.description: disconnected, connecting, connected, in-room or reconnecting.

my-id.description: Your player id inside the room.

resumed.description: 1 if the last room join was a return to a room you were already in.

room-count.description: Number of rooms in the last room list.

room-name-at.description: Name of the room at index.

room-players-at.description: Players in the room at index.

room-max-at.description: Max players of the room at index.

player-count.description: Number of players in the room.

player-id-at.description: Player id at index (sorted by id).

player-user-id.description: Permanent user id of a player.

player-prop.description: A property of a player (booleans are 1 or 0).

last-player-id.description: Player id from the last player trigger.

event-from.description: Player id that sent the last event.

state.description: Value of a state key (booleans are 1 or 0, missing = 0).

changed-key.description: Key of the last state change.

changed-value.description: New value of the last state change.

changed-old.description: Previous value of the last state change.

changed-by.description: Player id that made the last state change.
